- **Trust decision:** `EmbeddedServer.start()` turns auth on only when `OPENCLAW_SERVER_TOKEN` is set (`src/embedded-server.ts:58-71`). The single Bearer check for all non-`/health` routes (`src/embedded-server.ts:147-154`) runs only when that token exists. The fix makes auth the default and adds cookie and query-string token options.
- **`pattern_fit`:** `B`, weak. The protection is one central check, plus a client change in `bin/cli.ts`.
- **Strongest lever:** the SessionManager auto-proxy (`src/session-manager.ts:1193-1232`) is a second local HTTP server with no auth at all. It forwards requests using the server's stored LLM API keys. It is easy to dismiss as an internal helper on a random port. Next is the dashboard: its EventSource connections can't send a header, so a header-only fix breaks it.
- **Biggest red flag:** this is effectively a single-site fix in a small repo. Also, the auto-proxy guards a different target (LLM credentials, not session control), so it may not count as the "same protected target". No formal red flags are set; I couldn't measure repo size, so `tiny_repo` is likely but not confirmed.
